kind.title: Kind
kind.summary: A type that supplies the principle used to identify its instances. An instance remains a member throughout its existence.
kind.question: What makes this the same individual after its state or relationships change?
kind.example: Person supplies identity; Student borrows that identity.

subkind.title: Subkind
subkind.summary: A permanent specialization that inherits an identity principle from an identity provider.
subkind.question: Can an individual stop belonging to this type while remaining the same individual? If yes, reconsider the stereotype.

role.title: Role
role.summary: A temporary classification that inherits identity and depends on a relationship. Leaving the role does not destroy the individual.
role.question: Which mandatory relationship makes an individual play this role?
role.example: A Person becomes a Student through an Enrollment and can later stop being a Student.

phase.title: Phase
phase.summary: A temporary classification determined by intrinsic properties. Phases inherit identity and belong to a disjoint, complete partition.
phase.question: Which intrinsic property determines this phase, and do the alternatives cover all instances without overlap?
phase.example: Living and Deceased partition Person. A connection to another person does not determine these phases.

relator.title: Relator
relator.summary: An individual that grounds a relationship between other individuals and depends on them. Its mediations must require at least two participants in total.
relator.question: What relationship instance has its own identity and lifecycle?
relator.example: Enrollment connects a Student and a School. It can have a start date and its own termination.

mode.title: Mode
mode.summary: An intrinsic dependent individual without a structured value. It exists in exactly one bearer through characterization.
mode.question: What is its bearer, and why model this as an individual rather than an attribute?
mode.example: A skill or disposition depends on the person who has it.

quality.title: Quality
quality.summary: An intrinsic dependent individual with a structured value, such as a measurable height or weight. It characterizes exactly one bearer.
quality.question: What value space describes this quality, and which individual bears it?

collective.title: Collective
collective.summary: An identity provider for a collection whose members contribute uniformly to it.
collective.question: Do the members contribute in the same way, and what preserves the collection's identity when membership changes?

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.summary: An identity provider for an amount of matter. Its parts are essential to that particular quantity.
quantity.question: Is this an amount of matter, rather than a count or numerical value?

category.title: Category
category.summary: A permanent classification shared by individuals with different identity principles. It does not supply their identity.
category.question: Which different identity providers are grouped by this shared property?

mixin.title: Mixin
mixin.summary: A classification spanning different identity principles that may be permanent for some instances and contingent for others.
mixin.question: Which instances must belong and which can leave while keeping their identity?

roleMixin.title: Role mixin
roleMixin.summary: A temporary, relationally dependent classification spanning different identity principles.
roleMixin.question: Which different kinds can play this role, and which relationship makes them do so?

phaseMixin.title: Phase mixin
phaseMixin.summary: A temporary classification spanning different identity principles and determined by intrinsic properties.
phaseMixin.question: Which intrinsic condition is shared across these different identity providers?

mediation.title: Mediation
mediation.summary: Connects a relator to an individual on which it depends. Read the count at each end from one instance at the opposite end.
mediation.question: Which participants must exist for this relationship instance to exist?
mediation.example: For each Enrollment, exactly one Student; for each Student, one or more Enrollments if enrollment is required for that role.

characterization.title: Characterization
characterization.summary: Connects an intrinsic aspect to its bearer. The aspect depends on exactly one bearer.
characterization.question: Can this aspect exist without this bearer?

material.title: Material relation
material.summary: A relationship grounded by a relator and its mediations.
material.question: Which relator makes the relationship true?
material.example: A Student studies at a School because an Enrollment connects them.

formal.title: Formal relation
formal.summary: A relationship that holds directly between its participants without requiring a relator to ground it.
formal.question: What properties of the participants are sufficient for this relationship to hold?

componentOf.title: Component of
componentOf.summary: A part-whole relation where parts contribute different functions to a functional whole.
componentOf.question: What function does the part perform for the whole?

memberOf.title: Member of
memberOf.summary: A part-whole relation connecting a member to a collective.
memberOf.question: Does each member contribute uniformly to the collection?

generalization.title: Generalization
generalization.summary: Every instance of the specific type is also an instance of the general type. The hollow triangle points to the general type.
generalization.question: Is every instance of the specific type necessarily an instance of the general type?

association.title: Association
association.summary: A link between instances of two types. Its multiplicities constrain the number of instances allowed at each end.
association.question: Is this relationship intrinsic, grounded by a relator, or a direct relation? Record the reason if its stereotype is unresolved.
